items.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995…
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...my name is Dr. Michael Woods... [INTERVIEWEE] Well I’m glad to be here, I think.

ctx.x: Houston Person is a tenor saxophonist who is equally comfortable in a jazz quartet or with an organ based trio that leans towards R&B. Born in 1934, Houston grew up in South Carolina and was fortunate to play with future jazz greats Eddie Harris and Cedar Walton while in the military. He later attended the Hartt School of Music and toured with a number of organ trios. Houston has recorded numerous albums as a leader and enjoys a long time collaboration with singer Etta Jones.
Mr. Person was interviewed by Michael Woods and Monk Rowe on May 29,

We are filming interviews for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and my name is Dr. Michael Woods, my colleague is Monk Rowe, and today we are going to be interviewing and just conversing and relaxing and having a good time with Houston Person. We are very pleased to have you here and talk to you about your involvement in jazz.
